Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. Have you ever noticed how love seems to touch every part of our lives? It shapes the way we connect, dream, and even make sense of the world around us. Together, we're about to dive into a journey inspired by C.S. Lewis and his thoughtful exploration, The Four Loves.
Lewis invites us to look closely at the many faces of love—affection, friendship, eros, and charity—and how each brings its own joys, risks, and transformative moments.
Maybe you've wondered what really separates friendship from romance, or how selfless love can blend with our own desires. These are just some of the questions we'll explore side by side.
As we peel back the layers, you'll discover how affection wraps us in comfort and familiarity, how friendship offers a rare and chosen connection, how eros stirs up deep longing, and how charity extends a kind of grace that asks for nothing in return.
What if understanding these different kinds of love could help us move past surface-level connections, toward something deeper and more meaningful? Lewis's reflections aren’t just about theory—they’re an invitation to see how love can lift us up, sometimes challenge us, and even change the way we walk through life.
So, let’s set out together. We’ll uncover the true depth of love—its power to fulfill, to stretch us, and to open our hearts in ways we might never have expected. This journey isn’t just about learning; it’s about growing in compassion and finding richer connections with others—and maybe even with ourselves.
